daily_breakdown.note: First zero-trade day. Candidates detected but all failed confidence gate.
Broad sell-off. 5/7 daily winners were candidates. Regime lag + confidence formula structural gap.
Continued tech weakness. PSQ reached 0.20 eff_conf — closest inverse ETF has ever been to gate.

pattern_assessment: Three consecutive zero-trade days on identical config. The organism is correctly rejecting low-confidence candidates, but the confidence formula has a structural gap that prevents inverse ETFs and defensive rotations from scoring above ~0.20. This is a known design limitation (INV-008), not a bug.

starvation_risk.projected_days_to_evolution: UNKNOWN — depends on market regime returning to conditions the confidence formula can capture
starvation_risk.mitigation: None warranted yet. The confidence formula is working as designed for breakout/momentum setups. Changing it for sell-off days is Phase C work requiring design discussion.
